0022600029.text: The Memphis Grizzlies host the Oklahoma City Thunder in the 9th game of Memphis's season, with both teams at 6-2. The Grizzlies (2-2 at home, 4-0 on the road) are on a two-game losing streak and sit 3rd in the Southwest, half a game back, while the Thunder (4-0 at home, 2-2 on the road) have won two straight and sit 2nd in the Northwest, also half a game back. Memphis is missing Scotty Pippen Jr. (out, back soreness) and Isaiah Stewart (day-to-day, knee, game-time decision), while Oklahoma City is without Cason Wallace (out, shoulder surgery), Chet Holmgren (out, knee), Jalen Williams (out, leg fracture), Jaylin Williams (out, back spasms), Nikola Topic (out, back), and Thomas Sorber (out, knee). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Memphis lost all three meetings in 2025-26, including a 117-116 defeat in Memphis on January 9, 2026.
